findings.reason: English is 'Unlike agent': the like is the viewer's, made on the agent. The Urdu possessive کا attaches it to the agent instead ('the agent's like'), a calque of English's object-first phrasing, while the mirrored star in the same file says ایجنٹ کو پسندیدہ سے ہٹائیں (remove the agent from favourites). The intent still lands - the filled heart's own state and the aria keep the referent unambiguous - so this is idiom, not a polarity error; but it is the tooltip AND accessible name of the filled heart, so a native reader hears the wrong possession every time. The proposal keeps the agent named while placing the like where it belongs.

observations.about: translator's visible change: card.get -> ڈاؤن لوڈ
observations.ruling: accepted, resolves first-audit F1 without a new defect
observations.evidence: Label-in-name holds on the bytes: card.get ڈاؤن لوڈ is a contiguous substring of card.download_aria '{name} ڈاؤن لوڈ کریں' (checked as a codepoint substring, not by eye). The word also matches the shipped ur sense of the action: 39 shipped ur values render download as ڈاؤن لوڈ and ui.chat.directory.folder.downloads already uses ڈاؤن لوڈز for the count noun, so the card and the detail page no longer name one action two ways. Peer locales that name the action rather than 'get' do the same (es Descargar, ru Скачать, vi Tải, zh-CN 下载). At 8 codepoints it is one shorter than the 9-codepoint حاصل کریں the first audit measured, so the width finding did not regress.

observations.about: translator's visible change: delist_confirm kept as the full phrase
observations.ruling: accepted; the first audit's nit N2 (shorten to ہٹا دیں) is reasonably declined
observations.evidence: The phrase Agent Hub سے ہٹائیں is a contiguous substring of details.delist_aria ایجنٹ کو Agent Hub سے ہٹائیں - the aria constraint the first audit itself set. The shorter ہٹا دیں would NOT be contained in that aria (ہٹائیں vs ہٹا دیں), so adopting N2 would have forced a second change to the aria and produced exactly the speech-control mismatch the note warns about. Naming the object in the primary button also matches peer decisions (fr Retirer du hub, ru Снять с публикации, vi Gỡ khỏi trung tâm). It is 6 -> 19 codepoints in a maxWidth xs dialog whose footer is flex-col-reverse at mobile and a nowrap row at sm; no pixel claim is made and the rendered check the first audit asked for is still outstanding because no browser is available to this run.

observations.about: translator's visible change: Agent Hub in all delist strings
observations.evidence: All seven delist-bearing values name Agent Hub (aria, title, body, confirm, tooltip, delisting, failure.delist); none says the bare ہب any more, and the tooltip the first audit cited as the inconsistent one now agrees with the aria on the same button. One verb root ہٹا carries every one of the seven delist values, distinct from حذف کریں (delete) and from the unpull wording used for skills, so 'delist' cannot be misread as deleting the agent. Non-delist strings keep the shipped Agent Hub spelling too (details.back_aria).

observations.about: mechanical verification (my own, beyond the repo validators)
observations.evidence: 41/41 keys, key order identical to English, no keys added or dropped, valid UTF-8 JSON, byte-identical to json.dumps(indent='\t') + trailing newline (so the generator's formatting is preserved). Placeholder sets identical for all 41 keys ({name}, {age}, {date}, {author}); zero ICU plural/select in both English and Urdu, so no CLDR category can be missing; zero markup, Rich tags, backticks, commands, flags, paths or identifiers to preserve; NFC-normalised; no manual bidi controls (U+200E/200F/202A-202E/2066-2069/061C absent); U+2026 in action.trying is the single ellipsis and there is no '...'; no Latin digits and no ASCII sentence punctuation in the target at all. Punctuation inventory is exactly Urdu ۔ (7), ، (4), ؟ (1), “ ” (2) plus the message's own ':' and '(' ')' pairs and the ellipsis - no Hindi danda.

One address form throughout: آپ plus polite کریں/جائیں (delist_body آپ اسے بعد میں دوبارہ اپ لوڈ کر سکتے ہیں); no تم/تو, no '!', no 'براہ کرم' padding where English has no 'please'. Product names stay Latin and untransliterated (Radient in 5, 11, 17, 35; Agent Hub in 16 and the delist family); Agent Hub is never wrapped in Urdu punctuation and keeps its position inside the sentence. Glossary terms used: agent -> ایجنٹ wherever the term appears, with singular/plural/oblique forms consistent (ایجنٹ، ایجنٹس، ایجنٹوں), matching the core glossary row.

hubAge returns the complete strict distance plus پہلے from ui.hub.comments.age.* ({count} دن پہلے; one and other are identical for سیکنڈ، منٹ، دن، سال and inflected for گھنٹہ/گھنٹے and مہینہ/مہینے), so card.updated renders '3 دن پہلے اپ ڈیٹ ہوا' with no second preposition, and details.created / details.last_modified render 'تخلیق کا وقت: 3 دن پہلے (10 اکتوبر، 2026)' with {date} already formatted by the i18n date layer (formatCalendarDate -> formatDate, not date-fns' English pattern). Urdu is verb-final, so the age-before-verb order is the natural one; English's 'keep the leading lowercase word' is a casing note that cannot apply to a caseless script. The inherited comment-age.ts behaviour of saying 'ago' for future dates is identical in every locale and predates this namespace - not a ur defect.
